title: rel0-3-0: Sidecar 0.3.0 mods (older)
description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.0: everything in rui1027d, plus projects keyed by the Rytm's slots (SAVE AS / copy / clear follow, the project trash), kits following SAVE / RELOAD KIT, NO + KIT / PATTERN reload on the Sidecar's pages, the poly sequencer's pages and keys (FUNC + YES undo, FUNC + DOWN menu), the SIDECAR MENU with WEB UI (the pairing code), and a freeze probe that reports a stuck Rytm screen to the Sidecar. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.0.elemod (sha256 893ed9a5...733ab). Needs Sidecar 0.3.0 on the Pi.
